description: Figure 2’s right-side plot is a grouped bar chart illustrating self-report accuracy (labeled as “Self-Report Accuracy (Inside Preferences)”) for two model categories under three conditions. The horizontal axis contains the categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini,” arranged left to right, with no additional axis label shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Inside Preferences)” and uses a linear scale from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick labels at regular 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). Each model category has three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: Control (gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark purple). For GPT-4o, the gray control bar is near 0.10, the light-blue bar is around 0.55, and the dark-purple bar is around 0.75; for GPT-4o-mini, the gray control bar is near 0.00, the light-blue bar is around 0.50, and the dark-purple bar is around 0.75. Vertical error bars are drawn on each bar (in the same general color family as the bars), indicating uncertainty intervals; no bars appear specially highlighted beyond the color coding, and the categories do not appear to be sorted by bar height.
